name: Schedule Panel (2 Tracks)
description: Upcoming schedule with two parallel tracks. 15 input lines ('time event1 (subline1) - event2 (subline2)'), the first 8 non-empty lines are shown, evenly distributed vertically. White panel, black text, logo. A footer text area at the bottom is configurable. Slides in from the right, one third of the screen width. A delay field (minutes, may be negative) is added to every displayed time.

delay.title: Delay in minutes (negative = ahead of schedule)

footer.title: Footer text (bottom of panel)
footer.default: All times are estimates and might change.

line1.title: Line 1
line1.description: Format: time event1 (subline1) - event2 (subline2). Empty lines are skipped; only the first 8 non-empty lines are shown.
